meaning.en: here begins the Kalagnirudra Upanishad
meaning.hi: यहाँ से कालाग्निरुद्र उपनिषद् आरंभ होती है

meaning.en: Samvartaka, identified with fire, is the seer
meaning.hi: संवर्तक अग्नि ऋषि हैं

meaning.en: the metre is Anushtup
meaning.hi: छंद अनुष्टुप है

meaning.en: the deity is the radiant Kalagnirudra
meaning.hi: श्री कालाग्निरुद्र देवता हैं

meaning.en: for the sake of pleasing Kalagnirudra
meaning.hi: श्री कालाग्निरुद्र की प्रसन्नता के लिए

meaning.en: its use is prescribed for wearing sacred ash as the tripundra
meaning.hi: भस्म त्रिपुण्ड्र धारण में इसका विनियोग है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then, to the radiant lord Kalagnirudra
meaning.hi: तब भगवान कालाग्निरुद्र से

meaning.en: Sanatkumara asked
meaning.hi: सनत्कुमार ने पूछा

meaning.en: teach me, lord, the true essence of the tripundra practice
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्, त्रिपुण्ड्र विधि का सच्चा तत्त्व सिखाइए

meaning.en: what is the substance
meaning.hi: द्रव्य क्या है

meaning.en: how many places is it worn on
meaning.hi: कितने स्थानों पर

meaning.en: what is its measurement
meaning.hi: इसका माप क्या है

meaning.en: what are its lines
meaning.hi: रेखा कैसी है

meaning.en: what are its mantras
meaning.hi: मंत्र कौन-से हैं

meaning.en: what is its power
meaning.hi: शक्ति क्या है

meaning.en: what deity governs it
meaning.hi: देवता कौन है

meaning.en: who is qualified to perform it
meaning.hi: कर्ता कौन है

meaning.en: and what is its result
meaning.hi: और फल क्या है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the radiant lord Kalagnirudra replied to him
meaning.hi: भगवान कालाग्निरुद्र ने उससे कहा

meaning.en: the substance is ash born of fire
meaning.hi: जो द्रव्य है वह अग्नि से उत्पन्न भस्म है

meaning.en: taken up with the five Brahma mantras beginning with Sadyojata
meaning.hi: सद्योजात आदि पाँच ब्रह्म मंत्रों से ग्रहण करके

words.sanskrit: agnih iti bhasma, vayuh iti bhasma, jalam iti bhasma, sthalam iti bhasma, vyoma iti bhasma

meaning.en: fire is ash, wind is ash, water is ash, earth is ash, space is ash
meaning.hi: अग्नि ही भस्म है, वायु ही भस्म है, जल ही भस्म है, पृथ्वी ही भस्म है, आकाश ही भस्म है

meaning.en: lifted up while reciting the verse beginning 'Manastoka'
meaning.hi: 'मानस्तोक' मंत्र से उठाकर

words.sanskrit: ma no mahantam iti jalena samsrijya

meaning.en: mixed with water while reciting the verse beginning 'Ma No Mahantam'
meaning.hi: 'मा नो महान्तम्' मंत्र से जल में मिलाकर

meaning.en: with the threefold long-life formula, on the head, forehead, chest and shoulders
meaning.hi: 'त्रियायुषम्' मंत्र से सिर, ललाट, वक्ष और कंधों पर

words.sanskrit: triyayushaih tryambakaih trishaktibhih tiryak tisrah rekhah prakurvita

meaning.en: with the threefold-life and three-eyed, threefold-power mantras, one should draw three horizontal lines
meaning.hi: त्रियायुष, त्र्यम्बक और त्रिशक्ति मंत्रों से तिरछी तीन रेखाएँ बनाए

words.sanskrit: vratam etat shambhavam sarveshu deveshu vedavadibhih uktam bhavati

meaning.en: this Shaiva discipline is declared by Vedic teachers among the practices of every deity
meaning.hi: यह शांभव व्रत सब देवताओं के प्रसंग में वेदवादियों द्वारा कहा गया है

words.sanskrit: tasmat tat samacharet mumukshuh na punarbhavaya

meaning.en: therefore one seeking liberation should practice it, so as not to be born again
meaning.hi: अतः मुमुक्षु इसका आचरण करे, ताकि पुनर्जन्म न हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha sanatkumarah papraccha pramanam asya tripundradharanasya

meaning.en: then Sanatkumara asked what authority supports the wearing of the tripundra
meaning.hi: तब सनत्कुमार ने त्रिपुण्ड्र धारण का प्रमाण पूछा

words.sanskrit: tridha rekha bhavati alalatat achakshushoh a murdhnoh a bhruvoh madhyatah cha

meaning.en: the three lines run from the forehead to the outer eyes, up to the crown, and meet between the brows
meaning.hi: तीन रेखाएँ ललाट से आँखों तक, मस्तक तक और भौहों के मध्य तक होती हैं

words.sanskrit: yasya prathama rekha sa garhapatyah cha akarah rajah bhurlokah svatma kriyashaktih rigvedah pratahsavanam maheshvarah devata iti

meaning.en: the first line stands for the household fire, the sound A, restless energy, the earthly realm, the individual self, the power to act, the Rig Veda, the morning offering, and the deity Maheshvara
meaning.hi: पहली रेखा गार्हपत्य अग्नि, अकार, रज, भूर्लोक, स्वात्मा, क्रियाशक्ति, ऋग्वेद, प्रातःसवन और महेश्वर देवता है

words.sanskrit: yasya dvitiya rekha sa dakshinagnih ukarah satvam antariksham antaratma ichchhashaktih yajurvedah madhyandinam savanam sadashivah devata iti

meaning.en: the second line stands for the southern fire, the sound U, clarity, the middle space, the inner self, the power of will, the Yajur Veda, the midday offering, and the deity Sadashiva
meaning.hi: दूसरी रेखा दक्षिणाग्नि, उकार, सत्व, अंतरिक्ष, अंतरात्मा, इच्छाशक्ति, यजुर्वेद, माध्यंदिन सवन और सदाशिव देवता है

words.sanskrit: yasya tritiya rekha sa ahavaniyah makarah tamah dyaurlokah paramatma jnanashaktih samavedah tritiyasavanam mahadevah devata iti

meaning.en: the third line stands for the offering fire, the sound M, stillness, the heavenly realm, the supreme self, the power of knowing, the Sama Veda, the evening offering, and the deity Mahadeva
meaning.hi: तीसरी रेखा आहवनीय अग्नि, मकार, तम, द्युलोक, परमात्मा, ज्ञानशक्ति, सामवेद, तृतीय सवन और महादेव देवता है

meaning.en: thus one performs the rite of the tripundra with ash
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार भस्म से त्रिपुण्ड्र विधि की जाती है

words.sanskrit: yah vidvan brahmachari grihi vanaprasthah yatih va

meaning.en: whoever performs it with understanding, whether student, householder, forest-dweller, or renunciant
meaning.hi: जो विद्वान् ब्रह्मचारी, गृही, वानप्रस्थ या यति करता है

meaning.en: he becomes purified of every great fault and every small one
meaning.hi: वह महापातकों और उपपातकों से शुद्ध हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: sa sarveshu tirtheshu snatah bhavati, sa sarvan vedan adhitah bhavati, sa sarvan devan jnatah bhavati

meaning.en: it is as if he has bathed in every sacred water, learned every scripture, and come to know every deity
meaning.hi: मानो उसने सब तीर्थों में स्नान किया, सब वेद पढ़े, सब देवताओं को जाना

meaning.en: he becomes one who ceaselessly repeats every mantra of Rudra
meaning.hi: वह निरंतर सकल रुद्र मंत्रों का जप करने वाला बनता है

words.sanskrit: sa sakala-bhogan bhunkte deham tyaktva shiva-sayujyam eti

meaning.en: he enjoys every good thing, and on leaving the body becomes one with Shiva
meaning.hi: वह सब भोगों का आनंद लेता है, देह त्यागकर शिव-सायुज्य पाता है

words.sanskrit: na sa punaravartate na sa punaravartate

meaning.en: he does not come back, he does not come back
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता, वह फिर नहीं लौटता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever studies this teaching
meaning.hi: जो कोई इसका अध्ययन करता है

meaning.en: attains that very same state
meaning.hi: वह भी उसी अवस्था को प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: this is the truth; thus ends the Upanishad
meaning.hi: यही सत्य है; यहीं उपनिषद् समाप्त होती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
